title: Telangana Employees & Journalists Health Scheme (EJHS) Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Cashless healthcare scheme for eligible Telangana government employees, pensioners and accredited journalists and their dependants.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility depends on employment/pension/accreditation category and current Telangana EJHS rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Telangana Employees & Journalists Health Scheme (EJHS).

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
